p.src: 1  Send the lambs for the ruler of the land from Selah to the wilderness, to the mountain of the daughter of Zion.

ja: りなさい。 セラから荒野を通り、 シオンの娘の山へ。
en: Send the lambs for the ruler of the land from Selah to the wilderness, to the mountain of the daughter of Zion.
u.src: 1  Send the lambs for the ruler of the land from Selah to the wilderness, to the mountain of the daughter of Zion.

p.src: 2  For it will be that as wandering birds, as a scattered nest, so will the daughters of Moab be at the fords of the Arnon.

ja: さまよう鳥のように、 巣を追われた鳥のように、 モアブの
en: For it will be that as wandering birds, as a scattered nest, so will the daughters of Moab be at the fords of the Arnon.
u.src: 2  For it will be that as wandering birds, as a scattered nest, so will the daughters of Moab be at the fords of the Arnon.

p.src: 3  Give counsel! Execute justice! Make your shade like the night in the middle of the noonday! Hide the outcasts! Don’t betray the fugitive!

en: Give counsel! Execute justice! Make your shade like the night in the middle of the noonday! Hide the outcasts! Don’t betray the fugitive!
u.src: 3  Give counsel! Execute justice! Make your shade like the night in the middle of the noonday! Hide the outcasts! Don’t betray the fugitive!

p.src: 4  Let my outcasts dwell with you! As for Moab, be a hiding place for him from the face of the destroyer. For the extortionist is brought to nothing. Destruction ceases. The oppressors are consumed out of the land.

ja: たちを、 あなたのもとに
まわせよ。 モアブにとって、破壊する
は消え失せ、 滅びは
en: Let my outcasts dwell with you! As for Moab, be a hiding place for him from the face of the destroyer. For the extortionist is brought to nothing. Destruction ceases. The oppressors are consumed out of the land.
u.src: 4  Let my outcasts dwell with you! As for Moab, be a hiding place for him from the face of the destroyer. For the extortionist is brought to nothing. Destruction ceases. The oppressors are consumed out of the land.

p.src: 5  A throne will be established in loving kindness. One will sit on it in truth, in the tent of David, judging, seeking justice, and swift to do righteousness.

ja: えられる。 一人の者がダビデの天
en: A throne will be established in loving kindness. One will sit on it in truth, in the tent of David, judging, seeking justice, and swift to do righteousness.
u.src: 5  A throne will be established in loving kindness. One will sit on it in truth, in the tent of David, judging, seeking justice, and swift to do righteousness.

p.src: 6  We have heard of the pride of Moab, that he is very proud; even of his arrogance, his pride, and his wrath. His boastings are nothing.

ja: ぶっている。 その傲慢と
いた。 その自慢はむなしい。
en: We have heard of the pride of Moab, that he is very proud; even of his arrogance, his pride, and his wrath. His boastings are nothing.
u.src: 6  We have heard of the pride of Moab, that he is very proud; even of his arrogance, his pride, and his wrath. His boastings are nothing.

p.src: 7  Therefore Moab will wail for Moab. Everyone will wail. You will mourn for the raisin cakes of Kir Hareseth, utterly stricken.

ja: それゆえ、モアブはモアブのために
ぶ。 あなたがたは打ちのめされ、 キル・ハレセテの
en: Therefore Moab will wail for Moab. Everyone will wail. You will mourn for the raisin cakes of Kir Hareseth, utterly stricken.
u.src: 7  Therefore Moab will wail for Moab. Everyone will wail. You will mourn for the raisin cakes of Kir Hareseth, utterly stricken.

p.src: 8  For the fields of Heshbon languish with the vine of Sibmah. The lords of the nations have broken down its choice branches, which reached even to Jazer, which wandered into the wilderness. Its shoots were spread abroad. They passed over the sea.

ja: と、 シブマのぶどうの
の支配者たちは、 その
を打ち砕いた。 その
en: For the fields of Heshbon languish with the vine of Sibmah. The lords of the nations have broken down its choice branches, which reached even to Jazer, which wandered into the wilderness. Its shoots were spread abroad. They passed over the sea.
u.src: 8  For the fields of Heshbon languish with the vine of Sibmah. The lords of the nations have broken down its choice branches, which reached even to Jazer, which wandered into the wilderness. Its shoots were spread abroad. They passed over the sea.

p.src: 9  Therefore I will weep with the weeping of Jazer for the vine of Sibmah. I will water you with my tears, Heshbon, and Elealeh: for on your summer fruits and on your harvest the battle shout has fallen.

ja: それゆえ、私はヤゼルとともに、 シブマのぶどうの
く。 ヘシュボンよ、エルアレよ、 私は
であなたをぬらす。 あなたの
en: Therefore I will weep with the weeping of Jazer for the vine of Sibmah. I will water you with my tears, Heshbon, and Elealeh: for on your summer fruits and on your harvest the battle shout has fallen.
u.src: 9  Therefore I will weep with the weeping of Jazer for the vine of Sibmah. I will water you with my tears, Heshbon, and Elealeh: for on your summer fruits and on your harvest the battle shout has fallen.

p.src: 10  Gladness is taken away, and joy out of the fruitful field; and in the vineyards there will be no singing, neither joyful noise. Nobody will tread out wine in the presses. I have made the shouting stop.

ja: られた。 ぶどう畑では
もない。 ぶどう搾り場でぶどうを
もいない。 わたしが喜びの叫びをやめさせた。
en: Gladness is taken away, and joy out of the fruitful field; and in the vineyards there will be no singing, neither joyful noise. Nobody will tread out wine in the presses. I have made the shouting stop.
u.src: 10  Gladness is taken away, and joy out of the fruitful field; and in the vineyards there will be no singing, neither joyful noise. Nobody will tread out wine in the presses. I have made the shouting stop.

p.src: 11  Therefore my heart sounds like a harp for Moab, and my inward parts for Kir Heres.

ja: それゆえ、私の心はモアブのために
き、 私の胸の内はキル・ヘレスのために
en: Therefore my heart sounds like a harp for Moab, and my inward parts for Kir Heres.
u.src: 11  Therefore my heart sounds like a harp for Moab, and my inward parts for Kir Heres.

p.src: 12  It will happen that when Moab presents himself, when he wearies himself on the high place, and comes to his sanctuary to pray, that he will not prevail.

en: It will happen that when Moab presents himself, when he wearies himself on the high place, and comes to his sanctuary to pray, that he will not prevail.
u.src: 12  It will happen that when Moab presents himself, when he wearies himself on the high place, and comes to his sanctuary to pray, that he will not prevail.

p.src: 13  This is the word that the LORD spoke concerning Moab in time past.

en: This is the word that the LORD spoke concerning Moab in time past.
u.src: 13  This is the word that the LORD spoke concerning Moab in time past.

p.src: 14  But now the LORD has spoken, saying, “Within three years, as a worker bound by contract would count them, the glory of Moab shall be brought into contempt, with all his great multitude; and the remnant will be very small and feeble.”

ja: はこう言った。 「雇われ人が日数を数えるように、
すべてとともに卑しめられる。
はごくわずかとなり、 力を失う。」
en: But now the LORD has spoken, saying, “Within three years, as a worker bound by contract would count them, the glory of Moab shall be brought into contempt, with all his great multitude; and the remnant will be very small and feeble.”
u.src: 14  But now the LORD has spoken, saying, “Within three years, as a worker bound by contract would count them, the glory of Moab shall be brought into contempt, with all his great multitude; and the remnant will be very small and feeble.”
